newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 5.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Video arcade tycoon Chou Jen-shen and his wife given 10 and a half years as well as seven years, respectively for bribery; ordered to pay a record T$1.5 billion fine.
Japanese sedans allowed to be imported to Taiwan; car prices expected to drop.

UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan lifts a 23-year ban on Japanese sedan import after completing World Trade Organization entry talks with Japan, 7,700 units for 1996, and 10,000 in the first year after Taiwan joins WTO.
Video arcade tycoon sentenced to 10 and a half years in jail for bribery.
LIBERTY TIMES - Japanese sedans to be allowed in by mid-February, WTO talks with Japan completed.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - 7,700 japanese sedans to be allowed in after the Lunar Chinese new year.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to import 7,700 Japanese cars after the lunar new year as part of its bid to join WTO.
